description: Connects one Facebook Page (pageId from meta_leads_status connectablePages) so each Lead Ads lead lands on the Leads page within seconds as a Facebook or Instagram lead with its form answers, and starts the lead follow-ups. Your user must have signed in with Facebook on Connections first. Connecting a Page that needs reconnecting fixes it and runs the leads that waited. Nothing is sent to anyone. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: connect_facebook_page
title: Connect a Facebook Page for Meta Lead Ads
